== Enshrined deities ==
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shiotsuchi no Okina}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izanagi no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izanami no Mikoto}}

== Shrine crest ==
* Paulownia (5-7 kiri)

== History ==
The founding date is unknown, and it is one of the candidate shrines (Ronsha) for a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. Originally only Shiotsuchi no Okina was enshrined, but in the 2nd year of {{ill|Shōtai|de|Shōtai|fa|شوتای|fr|Ère Shōtai|ia|Shotai|id|Shōtai|ja|昌泰|ko|쇼타이 (연호)|ru|Сётай|simple|Shōtai|sr|Шотаи|tr|Shōtai|uk|Сьотай|zh|昌泰 (日本)|zh_yue|昌泰|qid=Q1324780}} it is said that Izanagi and Izanami were invited from Kumano in Kii Province. In Meiji 9, it was ranked as a village shrine.
